definitions.explanation: A record of events, activities, or observations kept on a daily basis, typically in a professional, institutional, or organizational context. Unlike a personal diary, a {日誌|にっし} is usually an official or work-related record.

examples.japanese: ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧{日誌|にっし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{日誌|にっし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日課|にっか}→日課：00317_nikka⟧だ。
examples.english: Keeping a daily log is part of my routine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}→工事現場：26202_koujigenba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧{日誌|にっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧づけられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: At construction sites, filling out a daily work log is mandatory.

examples.japanese: {航海|こうかい}{日誌|にっし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天候|てんこう}→天候：03558_tenkou⟧や⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The ship's log had detailed records of the weather and sea conditions.

notes:
Composed of {日|にっ} (day) and {誌|し} (record, chronicle). The word emphasizes systematic, daily record-keeping in a professional or institutional setting. It is distinct from ⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧ (personal diary), which is more private and reflective.

Various types of {日誌|にっし} are standard practice in Japanese workplaces and institutions: ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧{日誌|にっし} (work log), ⟦{保育|ほいく}→保育：11461_hoiku⟧{日誌|にっし} (childcare log at nurseries), {航海|こうかい}{日誌|にっし} (ship's log), and ⟦{学級|がっきゅう}→学級：12253_gakkyuu⟧{日誌|にっし} (class diary, kept by students on rotation).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧{日誌|にっし}: work log, operations log
- {航海|こうかい}{日誌|にっし}: ship's log
- ⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧{日誌|にっし}: work/operations diary
- ⟦{学級|がっきゅう}→学級：12253_gakkyuu⟧{日誌|にっし}: class diary
- {日誌|にっし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to keep a daily log
- {日誌|にっし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fill in the daily log

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧: diary — a personal diary; more subjective and private than {日誌|にっし}
- ⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧: record — broader term for any kind of record, not necessarily daily
- ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧: report — a formal written report, typically about a specific topic rather than daily routine
